title: Kairos TCK (technology compatibility kit) bundle and case
description: The conformance bundle tck/kairos-tck.json produced by tck/build.mjs, or a single case taken from it. A case is one evaluator invocation (list or next) with every input made explicit (from, to, tz, supply) and the expected CliReport semantics baked from the reference implementation: points (epoch ms), dates, out-of-coverage annotations, labels, coverage summary and warnings on success, or error.kind and error.message on failure. The vocabulary is that of schema/cli-report.schema.json; version, command and the from/to echoes of the report are not repeated. Rationale: spec/60-firing-layer-profile.md A.1 (an evaluator of its own must return the same acceptance, the same points and the same diagnostics as the reference implementation).

kairosLang.description: version of the reference implementation (impl/package.json) the expectations were baked with

implSha.description: fingerprint of impl/src + impl/stdlib: the first 12 hex digits of sha256 over the seven source files and three stdlib files, the same formula as tools/build-playground.mjs

cases.description: sorted by id; ids are unique

id.description: doctest/<dir>/<file>.md#<nn> (nn = 1-based index of the ```kairos block in the file) or manifest/<name> (tck/cases/<name>.kairos)

layer.description: doctest: an executable example from reference/, stdlib/, design/40-examples/, recipes/ or skills/kairos-authoring/ (the same blocks impl/test/doctest.test.ts runs). manifest: a hand-written case moved from a witness in impl/test

origin.description: where the case comes from: '<file> 実行例 N' for doctest, 'impl/test/<file>: <name of the it>' for manifest

source.description: the complete definition the evaluator receives (for doctest blocks that use @JP without defining it, the standard prelude of impl/test/helpers.ts is prepended)

from.description: start of the evaluation range [from, to) for list; the search origin for next

to.description: list only: exclusive end of the evaluation range

tz.description: the --tz the labels and range endpoints are read in; always explicit so no case depends on the machine's time zone

n.description: next only: the -n value (0 is a usage-error case)

horizonYears.description: next only: the --horizon value (0 is a usage-error case)

supply.description: the static bundle passed as --supply (the form schema/supply.schema.json describes): keys are binding names or premise.binding

additionalProperties.description: one resolved value in the shape the CLI accepts (covering, asof, and dates or instants). The contents may violate the supply contract on purpose (a non-existent date, a non-integer instant, a label outside the declared domain): those cases expect error.kind supply from the evaluator

results.description: one entry per body expression, in document order (same as CliReport.results)

coverage.description: the coverage summary; the runner compares it as a set (sorted by source and covering)

warnings.description: implementation warnings (horizon-clip, window-clip ...), in order; compared in the text stage

requested.description: next only: the number of firings asked for (-n); compared in the strict stage

found.description: next only: the number of firings actually found (< requested when the horizon ran out); strict

to.description: next only: the end of the search window the evaluator settled on (the day after the last firing); strict

message.description: the diagnostic (Japanese is canonical); compared in the text stage

points.description: epoch milliseconds, strictly ascending: the identity of each point (strict)

dates.description: civil labels of the points in tz, one-to-one with points (strict)

annotations.description: out-of-coverage intervals clipped to the range (strict: fromMs, toMs, source, covering; text: asof)

labels.description: present exactly when the reference report has results[].labels (the expression names exactly one labelled binding); same length as dates (strict, including presence)

uid.description: fingerprint of the expression (compared only with --check-uid)

asof.description: text stage: the appended '（宣言 asof … と不一致）' is wording
